subject: PUBLIC SCHEDULE FOR MAYOR ZOHRAN KWAME MAMDANI FOR MONDAY, JUNE 8, 2026
plaintextBody:
*Press Schedule*:
*10:00 AM – Holds Press Conference with Governor Kathy Hochul to Make a World Cup Announcement*
"The Mayor will take questions at this event."
"This event will be streamed live and available on Encompass Port CTY-3653."
*5:00 PM – Appears on Linea Abierta - Radio Bilingue*
*7:00 PM – Joins NYPL for "The Fourth Branch" Book Launch*
